    agents.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents MCP agents_list

    List AgentFlow agents

    Agents in the AgentFlow org chart (AI agents, humans and teams), in saved order. Filters: status, kind, project (id or name) and q (name, role, purpose, inputs, outputs, tools).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    statusenumOne of draft, active, paused, retired.
    kindenumOne of agent, human, team.
    projectstringProject id or name.
    qstring
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "draft",
        "active",
        "paused",
        "retired"
      ]
    },
    "kind": {
      "enum": [
        "agent",
        "human",
        "team"
      ]
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Project id or name."
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    agents.work read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/work MCP agents_work

    Get an agent's work queue

    What a runner needs to work as this agent: its brief and its queue, the open DevOps cards delegated to it (cards.update agents, or the card's Delegated to picker). Order: doing, requests, blocked, uat, must, nice (work in progress first; Blocked and UAT wait on others), then soonest due date, then #number. columns narrows the queue, e.g. ["doing","requests"] for cards it can act on now. Report back with cards.update (checklist, links) and cards.move.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    agentstringrequiredAgent id or name.
    columnsstring[]Only these columns (comma-separated in a query string).
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "agent": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Agent id or name."
    },
    "columns": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "requests",
          "doing",
          "blocked",
          "uat",
          "done",
          "must",
          "nice"
        ],
        "description": "Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have)."
      },
      "description": "Only these columns (comma-separated in a query string)."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "agent"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    agents.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents MCP agents_create

    Create an AgentFlow agent

    Add an agent to the AgentFlow org chart. References (reportsTo, supervisor, projects, cards, items) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400, and a reporting loop with reports_loop.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    namestringrequired
    kindenumagent (AI agent), human or team. One of agent, human, team.
    titlestringRole, e.g. Research.
    statusenumOne of draft, active, paused, retired.
    reportsTostringThe agent it reports to: id or name; "" for top level.
    supervisorstringA person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; "" for none.
    purposestring
    instructionsstringSystem prompt or runbook.
    runtimestringWhere it runs, e.g. T3 or a home server.
    modelstring
    inputsstring[]What it takes in.
    outputsstring[]What it produces.
    toolsstring[]What it may use.
    projectsstring[]
    cardsstring | integer[]
    itemsstring[]
    xnumberCanvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager.
    ynumber
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120
    },
    "kind": {
      "enum": [
        "agent",
        "human",
        "team"
      ],
      "description": "agent (AI agent), human or team."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 120,
      "description": "Role, e.g. Research."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "draft",

    agents.delete write

    DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent} MCP agents_delete

    Delete an AgentFlow agent

    Remove an agent. Its direct reports move up to its manager, and workflow steps it ran become unassigned.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    agentstringrequiredAgent id or name.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "agent": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Agent id or name."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "agent"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    deletedstringrequired
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    },
    "deleted": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "rev",
    "deleted"
  ]
}

    curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/agents/Researcher" \

  "rev": 58,
  "deleted": "a1"
}
